job_spec.structural_change: Two routes failed GRT congestion (cp1 M2-M6, cx1 M2-M5; cx1 congestion-30.rpt: all 5,178 markers in x 90-160 = the 20.1 um centre channel and the macro edges facing it, nets q[1]/q[0]/c_wd). Cause: both macro columns R0 with the six instances in dictionary order, so each rd mux and each wd bit joined a bank-0 and a bank-1 macro of DIFFERENT columns and rows; the centre channel mouth carried 1,587 bits on 977 tracks (1.62). cx2: the two macros of a pair share ONE channel (pair 0 left column rows 1+2 R0 -> left margin, pair 1 right column rows 1+2 MY -> right margin, pair 2 row 3 left MY + right R0 -> centre), so the rd mux and the wd trunk are local; outline 259.2 -> 280.8 um wide (centre channel 20.1 -> 35.6 um); channel-mouth cuts left 0.471 / centre 0.41 / right 0.467 (M3 + M5 less 15 % PG; M5 over the macros not counted). N-face pins locked per bit over the channel each bit descends in (M3, 3 tracks per pin). LEF check: rd_out[255:0] and wd_in[136:0] share macro edge A, wd_in[255:137] is on edge B, so mirroring the whole right column (the FACE2 proposal) would have put 1,230 bits into each margin. Kit recipe 2 (hold margin 30 ps, 5.4 um halo, flops at pins) + 6.0 um M5 no-entry strip inside both vertical edges of every SRAM. RTL unchanged (byte-identical), bench latency unchanged; vm_cp_bench + XBUS mutant (slice write-data bits swapped) bound in the job.
